_comment: Which menu categories each city's ontology is EXPECTED to cover.
PoolBuilder.build_pools raises when a required base slot comes out empty,
because a category the ontology should have and does not is a mapping
regression — not a menu decision. A city list legitimately covers only what
that city serves, so it declares its set here and the check stays strict
A city absent from this file (bangalore, and any city falling back to the
default ontology) requires every mandatory base slot, which is the
behaviour that shipped before per-city ontologies existed.
Adding a category to a city's ontology? Add it here too, otherwise nothing
notices when a later workbook drops it again.
